Noor: Saffron discovered the sunshine trapezoid on my desk and is Very Committed. photo: https://cdn.redwood.app/saffron/3387654321_sun_trapezoid.jpg
Ben: oh wow 98e basking champion. look at that stripe pattern.
Kai: is that a corn snake? non-venomous, right?
Noor: yup, corn snake. super chill. shes obsessed with warm glass spots.
Lina: do you have a heat mat schedule? my partners snake once insisted on sitting in a mug.
Noor: heat pad on thermostat set to 29C for daytime, cool side at 22C. shes very persuasive about mugs though.
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "saffron_sunloop.mp4" 4f9 https://cdn.redwood.app/saffron/3387654321_sunloop.mp4
Ben: watched  0:06 when she flicks her tongue at the dust motes = 100% content.
Kai: poll: bring Saffron to next virtual all-hands pet spin? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Lina: :thumbsup: yes, small and camera-friendly
Noor: thanks! keeping this thread for documentation of the Great Trapezoid Migration. :snake:
